This is my main maize plot, so I need to make sure it produces enough food for my children. I received FISP coupons this year, so I will apply one bag of NPK and one bag of urea on this field, and I also have some compost from my chickens to mix in. I will plant the hybrid seed I got through the program because it grows better when there is fertilizer. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since the plot is small, and I cannot afford to hire ganyu workers this season.
